run_normalize_filter_text: run the script to normalize text from stdin and filter by language using fasttext
run_filter_by_language: run the script with a language id and threshold to filter stdin text lines
run_normalize_text: run the script to strip non-alphanumeric characters and normalize whitespace from stdin
run_with_fasttext_model: run the script with a custom fasttext model path for language identification filtering
run_without_language_filter: run the script without a fasttext model to normalize text without language filtering
